design_system.archetype: 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) - Adapted for Organic Minimalist Fitness
design_system.philosophy: Næste handling skal være klar. Light, clean, and distraction-free but with an energetic, authoritative typographic presence. Asymmetrical layouts create an editorial feel rather than a generic app landing page. Avoid all purple/teal AI defaults and boring Inter fonts.

rules.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento 'Tetris' grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12). Heavy use of asymmetry and overlapping elements.

motion_and_interactions.entrance: Staggered fade-up using Framer Motion (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> 1).
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Buttons scale (0.98) and darken. Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) with shadow-lg.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Slow organic drift for the Trust Strip using react-fast-marquee.

components.button: Flat, sharp or rounded-full. Primary uses Accent Color (#FF4F00) with pure white text. text-sm font-bold.
components.input: Large and airy (h-14). bg-surface border-b-2 border-transparent focus:bg-white focus:border-accent_primary transition-all.
components.cards: Flat background with 1px border. Avoid generic drop shadows. Inner padding p-8 minimum.
components.accordion: For FAQ: Large text, border-bottom only between items, no bounding box container.
components.dialog: For legal pages. Glassmorphism overlay (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) with solid white modal body.

page_sections.layout: Two columns (Desktop: 7 cols text, 5 cols visuals). Left-aligned. Mockup overlaps lifestyle image on the right.

content.headline: Træning uden støj. Næste handling er altid klar.
content.subheadline: Program før, log undervejs, historik efter. Alt samlet i én rolig oplevelse. Skriv dig på ventelisten.
